column1: # Requirements built so far (tools/registers.py reads it). A row only when running code is verified by the
# evidence named; status says which layer is built (the entity and the procedures come in later phases).

column2: status
column3: evidence

column2: built in P0: NIA/NEA 0-2 and the protected header codec; in P1 N4 the UE NAS security context: K_NASint and K_NASenc from K_AMF, the 24-bit COUNTs with the overflow counter, the downlink COUNT estimated above the stored one (replays discarded, 4.4.3.2), integrity over the sequence number and message, ciphering from octet 8, BEARER 0 and DIRECTION; 5G-IA0 and the 3 algorithms refused
column3: U: tests/unit/proc NasSecurity (vectors from tests/oracles/keychain.py and the Python cryptography package), tests/unit/crypto; F: fuzz_nas_ies, fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: unknown non-imperative IEs ignored by the codec; in P1 N4 the typed IE codecs of every IE P1 interprets, each refusing contents its clause makes impossible (a section 7 corpus per IE); reporting stays with the entity
column3: U: tests/unit/nas NasIe (Clause7 corpus), tests/unit/nas; F: fuzz_nas_ies, fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: CP-DATA, CP-ACK, CP-ERROR codec; TC1* with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip; F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: RP-DATA, RP-ACK, RP-ERROR, RP-SMMA codec; timers and RP-DA from EF.SMSP with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip; F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: TPDU codec (SUBMIT, DELIVER, STATUS-REPORT, COMMAND, reports; TP-VP forms; TP-PI per 23.040 9.2.3.27), GSM 7-bit and UCS2; concatenation with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip (pycrate elements); F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: APDU codec; in P1 N3 the card: T=0 procedure bytes (61xx with GET RESPONSE, 6Cxx), status words, the ATR, MANAGE CHANNEL with 4 channels; the terminal runs the T=0 procedures
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card CardOs (TS 102 221 clauses), Terminal; F: fuzz_card

column2: built in P0: BER-TLV and FCP codec; in P1 N3 the card file system: MF, DF, ADF, transparent, linear fixed and cyclic EFs, SELECT by FID, path and AID, READ/UPDATE BINARY (and by SFI), READ/UPDATE/SEARCH RECORD, STATUS, ACTIVATE/DEACTIVATE, expanded-format ARR; pySim-shell over every EF comes in N14
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card CardOs; F: fuzz_card

column2: built in P0: MILENAGE and the AUTHENTICATE codec; in P1 N3 the card command: AUTHENTICATE in the 3G context with Milenage or TUAK from AF20 (sysmoISIM layout), RES/CK/IK, MAC failure 9862; in P1 N5 the ME side: RES*, K_AUSF, K_SEAF and K_AMF from the card's RES, CK and IK, and AUTS passed on for #21
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card Usim (35.208 sets, a 35.233 set through APDUs), Terminal

column2: built in P0: SUCI null scheme, Profile A and Profile B (ECIES); GET IDENTITY codec; in P1 N5 the ME computes the null-scheme SUCI from EF.IMSI, EF.AD and EF.Routing_Indicator (D6); Profiles A and B in use are deferred (P2+)
column3: U: tests/unit/crypto (33.501 C.4), oracle m12roundtrip, tests/unit/proc Suci; P: tests/procedure (the stub's MSIN check)

column2: built in P0: TUAK and MILENAGE-256 libraries (v1.x as card algorithms)
column3: U: tests/unit/crypto (35.233, 35.236 sets)

column2: built in P0: the key hierarchy library (33.501 Annex A: K_AUSF to K_AMF', NH, K_NG-RAN*)
column3: U: tests/unit/crypto keys5g_test (33.501 C.4 vectors); U: tests/oracles/keychain.py (10,000 inputs)

column2: built in P0: NEA/NIA 0-2 (SNOW 3G vendored from OCUDU); 128-NEA3/NIA3 not built (KS-SEC-G1)
column3: U: tests/unit/crypto (33.401 Annex C, 35.217 vectors)

column2: built in P0: the codec's PER coverage, SEQUENCE OF at its bounds (the N-20 class) probed; the procedure with the entity (P1)
column3: U: oracle probes and roundtrip (asn1c against pycrate and tshark); F: fuzz_asn1_ngap

column2: built in P0: GTPv1-U codec (header, extension chain, clause 8 IEs, every message type); the NG-U endpoint (Echo, Error Indication, the PDU Session Container) is P1 (N10), F1-U and Xn-U are P2 and P3
column3: U: tests/unit/up, oracle m12roundtrip (pycrate, tshark); F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: PDU Session Container DL type 0 and UL type 1, padding, what follows the last field kept
column3: U: tests/unit/up, oracle m12roundtrip (pycrate, tshark, OCUDU vectors); F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: NR-U DL USER DATA and DL DATA DELIVERY STATUS codec
column3: U: tests/unit/up, oracle m12roundtrip (tshark nrup, OCUDU vectors); F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: the pcapng writers and their framings (Exported-PDU, IPv4/UDP for GTP-U, GSMTAP-SIM with keys zeroed); per-interface capture with the nodes (P1+)
column3: U: tests/unit/platform pcapng_test (tshark), tools/secret_canary.py

column2: built in P1 N3: PIN1, PIN2 and ADM1 with retry counters; VERIFY, CHANGE, DISABLE, ENABLE and UNBLOCK PIN; updates gated by ADM1; a disabled PIN counts as verified
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card CardOs Clause11_1_9_To_13, Clause11_1_10, Clause9_2

column2: built in P1 N3: the SQN check of TS 33.102 Annex C with a SEQ/IND array (IND 5 bits) and the delta check, kept in AF30 (sysmoISIM layout); a stale SQN answers AUTS = SQN_MS xor AK* || MAC-S
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card Usim Annex_C (AUTS verified with our MILENAGE f1* and f5*)

column2: built in P1 N4: the split of an initial REGISTRATION REQUEST, DEREGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST into its cleartext IEs (24.501 4.4.6); in P1 N5 the procedure: the initial message with cleartext IEs only, then the whole REGISTRATION REQUEST in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE's NAS message container (no context, or RINMR); the protected initial message of a UE with a context is N12
column3: U: tests/unit/proc NasSecurity.Clause4_4_6; P: tests/procedure Mm.Clause5_4_2_3_RinmrBringsTheWholeRegistrationRequestBack

column2: built in P1 N5: the UE's 5GMM states and substates by their spec names, the update status 5U1-5U3, and a transition table with clauses that the entity keeps to (checked against the states extracted from 24.501 5.1.3.2.1); behaviour per substate grows with N12
column3: P: tests/procedure Mm.Clause5_1_3_2_1_TheStateTableNamesEachUeStateOfTheSpec

column2: built in P1 N5: initial registration with a null-scheme SUCI or a held 5G-GUTI, requested NSSAI and the UE security capability; the accept's 5G-GUTI, TAI list, allowed NSSAI, T3512 and T3502 taken; REGISTRATION COMPLETE for a new 5G-GUTI. SMS requested, DRX, equivalent PLMNs and the configured NSSAI come with N12/N13
column3: P: tests/procedure Mm.Clause5_5_1_2_InitialRegistrationWithANullSuciEndsRegistered

column2: built in P1 N5: rejects #3, #6, #7 (USIM invalid, NO-SUPI), #11, #12, #13, #15 and #27 to their states; the abnormal cases c, d and e of 5.5.1.2.7 with the attempt counter, T3510, T3511 and T3502 (counter at 5 for #95-#99 and #111, reset on T3502 expiry); forbidden lists, T3346, #22, #62, #72 and #73 are N12

column2: built in P1 N5: 5G AKA on the ME side: the USIM's AUTHENTICATE, RES*, K_AUSF, K_SEAF and K_AMF; the separation bit (#26), MAC (#20) and SQN (#21 with AUTS) failures, #71 for an ngKSI in use; the stored RAND and RES* with T3516; T3520 and the network failing the check; AUTHENTICATION REJECT. EAP-AKA' is N12

column2: built in P1 N5: security mode control: the candidate context checked before use, the replayed UE security capabilities (#23), 5G-IA0 and unoffered algorithms refused (#24), the IMEISV when asked, SECURITY MODE COMPLETE with header type 4 and the uplink COUNT from 0; a command under the current K_AMF keeps the COUNTs
